licence.scope: WP03.02 adds strict source-generated HTTP-exception JSON codecs, generated per-package service catalogues and the public binary-only transport export to the existing Apache-2.0 package closure. Schemas, generators and independent serialization vectors are Apache-2.0 repository material; third-party generator attribution and immutable prior records remain intact; no external product implementation is imported. CON.16 adds four signed-format roots and independently signed public conformance fixtures through the existing Apache-2.0 JSON shape generator.

verification.expected: Formal merged constraint-shard loader reproduces all generated bindings; exact input schemas, shards, fixtures and generator snapshots are retained.

notice.text: Selected ArcForges contract bindings are generated from Apache-2.0 schemas using Grpc.Tools 2.84.0, protoc-gen-es 2.15.0 and Connect-Kotlin 0.9.0. Shape validators, domain identity adapters and fixture exports use Apache-2.0 repository tooling. Historical protobuf BSD-3-Clause and applicable generator Apache-2.0 attributions are retained. Build tools are not bundled in client packages. Native-grpc-only Android generation remains retired.
notice.reason: The generated bindings are distributed. Every package NOTICE retains the applicable generator attribution and protobuf licence text; runtime dependency notices remain separate.
